ThingDef.label: vac barrier roof
ThingDef.description: A nanomachine-composed, transparent roof that functions as a standard roof without requiring any supports while allowing aircraft passage.\n\nThese nanomachines harvest energy from all kinds of gravitational waves, requiring no external power consumption.

ThingDef.label: advanced vac barrier roof
ThingDef.description: A nanomachine-composed, transparent roof with thick roof-level durability that requires no supports and allows aircraft passage.\n\nThese nanomachines harvest energy from all kinds of gravitational waves, requiring no power consumption.
